Enable language detection and inspect the ISO 639-3 code returned with the document.

```python title="Python"
import asyncio
from xberg import extract, ExtractInput, ExtractInputKind
from xberg._xberg import ExtractionConfig

async def main() -> None:
    input = ExtractInput(kind=ExtractInputKind("uri"), mime_type="text/plain", uri="https://example.com/text/report.txt")
    config = ExtractionConfig.from_json("{\"language_detection\":{\"detect_multiple\":false,\"enabled\":true,\"min_confidence\":0.5}}")
    result = await extract(input, config)
    print(result.results[0].detected_languages)

asyncio.run(main())
```
